subject.title: [Feature]: Per-user heartbeat routing for channel-level heartbeat messages

question: Should OpenClaw add a public WhatsApp/channel heartbeat recipient contract for OK-only acknowledgments, and what shape should that contract use?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear, but the fix adds a compatibility-sensitive config surface and must define field shape, precedence, validation, and alert/OK separation before implementation.

options.title: Add OK-only heartbeat recipients
options.body: Accept an additive target/targets-style contract that applies only to visible HEARTBEAT_OK acknowledgments and validates recipients against WhatsApp account and allowlist policy.

options.title: Use existing agent delivery only
options.body: Reject channel-level recipients and document agents.defaults.heartbeat.target/to plus showOk:false as the supported workaround, accepting that OK visibility and alert routing cannot be separated.

options.title: Defer to broader routing design
options.body: Keep the issue open but defer implementation until channel-level automated-message routing is designed alongside adjacent announce-suppression requests.

recommendation.title: Add OK-only heartbeat recipients
recommendation.body: Accept an additive target/targets-style contract that applies only to visible HEARTBEAT_OK acknowledgments and validates recipients against WhatsApp account and allowlist policy.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent merged history in the config/outbound target surfaces and already reviewed this issue's missing contract.
